hebrewText: וְ/הוּא֩ הֶעֱבִ֨יר אֶת בָּנָ֤י/ו בָּ/אֵשׁ֙ בְּ/גֵ֣י בֶן הִנֹּ֔ם וְ/עוֹנֵ֤ן וְ/נִחֵשׁ֙ וְֽ/כִשֵּׁ֔ף וְ/עָ֥שָׂה א֖וֹב וְ/יִדְּעוֹנִ֑י הִרְבָּ֗ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הַכְעִיסֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. practise magic
tokens.kjv: [idiom] bring, enchanter, Meonemin, observe(-r of) times, soothsayer, sorcerer.

tokens.bdb: properly, a knowing one; specifically, a conjurer; (by impl) a ghost

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant
tokens.kjv: be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.
